The presence of marked, thick-walled enhancement (Enhancement Quality: 'Marked', Thickness of enhancing margin: '>3mm') and central necrosis (Proportion Necrosis: 4.53%) are classic hallmarks of glioblastoma, the most common IDH-wildtype tumor. In this case, the presence of marked enhancement, central necrosis, and significant surrounding edema (ED Volume (mL): 74.407) are all features more commonly associated with astrocytic lineage tumors, which are non-codeleted.
